content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Mainly residential homeowners and condo insurance for coastal homes, not commercial specialty underwriting for businesses."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Its specialty commercial property and casualty insurance arm matches Bowhead's business, sold through agents and brokers, though it also runs annuities."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites specialty property, casualty and professional liability for businesses through agents and brokers, closely matching Bowhead's lines and channels."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"A brokerage earning commissions and fees for placing coverage, not an insurer underwriting risk and holding premiums."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"An online health and life insurance marketplace earning carrier commissions, not underwriting commercial specialty risk."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells consumer insurance leads and referrals to carriers and agencies, with no underwriting or risk-bearing business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells annuities and life insurance to individuals for retirement, a different customer and product set from commercial specialty lines."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites commercial property and liability for small businesses and contractors through agents, similar to Bowhead, though regional and with personal lines."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Primarily title and mortgage guaranty insurance serving homebuyers and lenders, with only a minor commercial general liability overlap."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites excess and surplus, commercial property and specialty risks through wholesale brokers and MGAs, closely matching Bowhead's business model."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Combines life insurance, home mortgages and cemetery services for individual families, a different business from specialty commercial insurance."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"A brokerage and program administrator earning commissions and fees, not an underwriter bearing risk on its own balance sheet."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Writes commercial multiple peril, workers' compensation and specialty commercial insurance through independent agents and brokers, overlapping Bowhead's core business."},{"label":"C14","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites excess and surplus, professional liability and commercial casualty for businesses through agents and wholesale brokers, very close to Bowhead."}]}
